instruction: Insert a 4(columns)*6(rows) empty table at the cursor position.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.press("down", presses=40, interval=0.01); time.sleep(1); pyautogui.scroll(-2)
import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent successfully inserted a 7x5 table at cursor position using Table > Insert Table dialog. Set columns to 7 and rows to 5, then clicked Insert.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can navigate LibreOffice Writer menus, open Insert Table dialog, configure column/row counts, insert tables at cursor position.
metadata.task_rationale: Same table insertion task with different dimensions (4 cols, 6 rows instead of 7 cols, 5 rows) to verify the model can generalize table insertion.
metadata.explanation: Custom getter reads the document, counts tables, and checks the last table dimensions. Original document has 1 table (11x7). After insertion, should have 2 tables with the last being 6 rows x 4 columns. Partial credit: 0.5 for new table existing, 0.25 for correct cols, 0.25 for correct rows.

scoring_breakdown.new_table_exists: 0.50 - A new table was inserted (table count >= 2)
